status: PASS route-blind symmetry strong control;no counterexample
verdict: G4 whole low-command maps cannot reach even the original cyclic capacity through any whole-layer identity/swap8 choices. Applying the same control to cyclic lowers its capacity further. This preserves G4 same-capacity concern rather than resolving it.
isomorphism_proof: Let pi(c)=c xor8 for16chips/8channels. pi preserves channel c mod8. Apply it jointly to every routed/shared GU/Down native job in a layer,with all job array positions and descriptors except chip unchanged.

Rename only chip array resources and chip-owner slots by pi. Host,serialized controller,channel resources,PCIe,GU barriers,Down privateinput,activation and combine are unchanged. Every operation keeps its duration,deps,phase,expert ordinal and nodeID.

The ready key is phase/expert/nodeID;command selection is the minimum eligible key across free chip owners. Unique nodeID prevents a chip-index tie-break from altering choice. Array resource starts in one loop pass do not enqueue successors until the subsequent completion batch,so permutation inside the array-resource range does not change same-time eligibility.

By induction over completion batches,start/end times remain equal after resource/chip renaming for any selected expert route. Chip-resource workloads and ownership sums permute;all other resource work and DAG critical paths are unchanged,so the reported lower bound is invariant too.

This is a proof about the declared homogeneous ordinary-read graph,not a measured native-hardware guarantee. Address-dependenttR,CR,unequal chips,other background queues or topology/priority costs would require a different proof.
route_blind_capacity_choice: Only static per-layer chip x wave-size histograms are read for selection. No routing frequencies,service costs,TRAIN/test records or heldout statistics select flips. The plans were already TRAIN fitted;this postfreeze transformation is independently route blind.

All layers in each map have the same swap-delta histogram,checked exactly. Therefore every binary choice with k flipped layers has identical aggregate histograms H_total+k*delta. Enumerating k=0..L covers all2^L swap assignments for BFD block counts.

For each k,compute BFD blocks from the size multiset. Select minimum total blocks,then maximum per-chip blocks,then wave imbalance,then k. First k layers are flipped as a deterministic index tie rule. Minimum-wave-load balance alone can increase capacity due to block rounding.

The fast bucket allocator reproduces the original root BFD full address array exactly before transformation. All transformed native job array positions remain intact;sorting is used only inside offline address packing. Full transformed arrays,logical rows,and physical interval maps are saved.

Each packing interval/page containment and full matrix row coverage are independently rechecked. Useful bytes,programmed pages,reserved waves,commands and coefficient one-copy identities remain identical to the original. No physical device operations are performed.
lower_bounds: For any k,at least sum_chip ceil(chip_total_waves(k)/192) block-index bundles are necessary. Minimum of this bound over k lower-bounds every binary swap layout even with an arbitrary bin packer.
23of24 maps attain that valid bound,certifying minimum total bundles inside this restricted symmetry family. This does not prove all possible mappings optimal.
v5 Deep5000ns disjoint:best BFD count1293,work LB1290. No binpacking optimality claim for that map;retained all count alternatives.

A second coordinatewise relaxation gives every chip independent choices per layer:ceil(sum_layer min(waves[c],waves[c xor8])/192). G4whole lowcommand gives32bundles/chip in both campaigns because minimum6048(v5)or5968(v6)waves exceeds31*192=5952. Thus32*16=512bundles=6GiB is unavoidable in this family.
G4cyclic reaches31bundles/chip after20of40 layer flips,with5940waves/chip. Its coordinatewise lower bound is31/chip,so496bundles=5.8125GiB is tight in this family.
